_about: Who to follow: Stephanie's list of the best voices in talent acquisition and the most helpful (or funniest) people for job seekers. Editorial, like her picks: never scored, never paid for, and no follower counts. Every link was taken from research, not guessed. Photos: each person's own public profile picture from their official YouTube channel or website, saved to /public/people so they can't break; the channel or page is confirmed as theirs by its own description or videos. Remove any photo on request. Without a confirmed photo, the card shows initials. approved=false: draft until Stephanie signs off. Held back: Mike Peditto (The Realistic Recruiter), because a source says he works at Teal, which we rank; Adam Karpiak, because no source confirmed the humor.

rows.title: The best in talent acquisition
rows.lead: The voices recruiting leaders actually read, watch and listen to.

rows.title: For job seekers
rows.lead: One to keep you laughing, the rest to get you hired.

people.name: Hung Lee
people.why: The weekly newsletter and live show TA leaders actually read and watch: what's changing in hiring, AI included.

people.name: Matt Alder
people.why: A talent acquisition futurist with over 25 years in the field, interviewing the TA leaders who are changing how hiring works.
people.photoSource: No confirmed personal photo found yet

people.name: Madeline Laurano
people.why: Founder and chief analyst at Aptitude Research, covering talent acquisition and hiring tech for over 18 years.

people.name: Adam Posner
people.why: Founder of NHP Talent Group, recording live with the TA leaders running hiring at companies like NBCUniversal and Toshiba.

people.name: Maureen Wiley Clough
people.why: Real talk about what's happening to mid-career workers, from fake job postings to age bias, with the recruiting leaders who can fix it.

people.name: Glen Cathey
people.why: The deepest free writing on sourcing there is, from Boolean search to AI in recruiting.

people.name: Katrina Collier
people.why: How to keep the human part of recruiting, from candidate experience to working with hiring managers.

people.name: Tim Sackett
people.why: A staffing firm president who writes about recruiting with jokes and sports analogies, and real advice under them.

people.name: Chad Sowash and Joel Cheesman
people.why: Irreverent weekly take on HR tech and hiring news from two industry veterans. Explicit language, honest opinions.

people.name: Madeline Mann
people.why: A former head of HR who walks through interview questions and offers like someone who has sat on the other side of the table, because she has.

people.name: Erin McGoff
people.why: Short, practical answers to the work questions nobody teaches you, from networking to delivering bad news.

people.name: Andrew LaCivita
people.why: Interview prep in depth: the hard questions, the stories to tell, and the questions to ask back.

people.name: Austin Belcak
people.why: How to get hired through referrals and direct outreach instead of another online application.

people.name: J.T. O'Donnell
people.why: A former recruiter's straight talk on why resumes go unanswered, with live Q&A for job seekers.
people.photoSource: No confirmed personal photo found yet

people.name: Corporate Natalie
people.why: Office-life comedy for anyone who has survived a reply-all. Both sides of the table will recognize themselves.
